annotations.text: FR-1.1 / FR-1.2 — sign-in, generic invalid-credentials message. Try leaving a field blank, or password “wrong”.
FR-3.1 / FR-3.3 — shell + placeholder dashboard. Open the account menu (top right) to preview other roles.
FR-4.1–FR-4.5 — search, pagination, and all four states. Use the “Preview state” pills or type a name/MRN, “error”, or a non-matching term.
FR-5.1–FR-5.4 — demographics only; explicitly notes what's not available yet. Try the copy-MRN button.

FR-6.7–FR-6.9, FR-6.14/FR-6.15 — Administrator-only. Same list/state pattern as Patient Search. Deactivate opens a confirm dialog; Reset password opens a new/confirm-password form (mismatch blocked inline); reactivate needs neither.
FR-6.12 / FR-6.13 — real CSV parsing (drop your own file, or “Try a sample file”). Per-row created/failed reporting.
FR-2.3 — shown when a role lacks access. Defaults to Auditor; switch roles in the account menu to see nav update.
FR-3.4 — unrecognized route. Standalone, no shell (can occur pre-auth).
FR-6.10 / FR-6.11 — same confirmation shown whether or not the account exists (anti-enumeration).
FR-6.10 — use the “Preview link state” toggle to see the expired/used/invalid-token case.
FR-6.16 — shown after logging in with a password an Administrator set. No skip/cancel affordance by design; blocks everything else until resolved.
